name: NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000 datasheet (March 2019 PDF)
notes: NVIDIA-hosted PDF 'Quadro RTX 8000 | Data Sheet | Mar19'. Same TU102 board as the RTX 6000 with doubled memory: 48 GB GDDR6, 384-bit, 672 GB/s, 4608 CUDA cores, 16.3 TFLOPS single precision, 295 W total board power, PCIe 3.0 x16. NVLink HB bridge quoted at 100 GB/s bidirectional.
